question: Who among the following is a shot put player from India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tajinderpal Singh Toor.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Tajinderpal Singh Toor **is a shot put player from India.
 
• He holds the outdoor Asian and national record of** 21.49m.**
 
• He won** Arjuna Award for Athletics.**
